notes.title: 🌟 OPEN ALPHA is available 🌟
notes.content:
We finally decided to let everyone access the app in an open Alpha! 
Nice and important features made their way in, bug fixes have been piling up... Most importantly, we realized we could now have real good fun with the app ourselves. 😁
There's still a lot to do of course, but we feel like more testers and more feedback would certainly help us continue into the right direction.

Particubes Alpha is not only available on Steam, you can download the app on your mobile too:
[b]-> [url=https://particubes.com/download]Download the app on iOS and Android[/url] <-
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38741870/26a07477aabb3450fe2a52592bf104404e32a855.png[/img]

Please remember this is an alpha , many features are still missing, but we want to see how it goes with what's available:
[list]
[*] Create an account / Sign in
[*] Explore featured worlds
[*] Create your own items and maps
[*] Create and script your own worlds
[/list]
The team and other community members can help you on [url=https://discord.com/invite/NbpdAkv]Discord[/url] .

notes.title: 🔧Updates : 0.0.21 & 0.0.22
notes.content:
As we want to better inform our community about the progress of the beta, changelog will also be published here! 

For these updates (0.0.21 & 0.0.22), we really focused on community feedback and fixing reported issues! We also introduced item previews! 

[b][h3]0.0.21 (May 28, 2021)[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] It's now possible to place "points" in the item editor. Well, one point actually for now, to position/rotate your item for when a player holds it. We will very soon add more points to wear items as hats & backpacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38741870/aed055d60566e6d884865737ea9176217e444b6a.png[/img]

[*] Other item editor improvements, like the visual feedback to indicate what cube the camera is looking at when moving the shape.
[*] Bug/crash fixes

[b]Developers:[/b]
[*] Use Player:SwingRight() and Player:SwingLeft() while holding an item to swing it.
[*] It's now clear that you can't declare Labels & Buttons before OnStart (both constructors are nil before that)
[/list]

[b][h3]0.0.22 (June 8, 2021)[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Leaving a game leads back to previous menu
[*] Item names are always lower-case
[*] Item Editor fixes and improvements
[*] Bug fixes

[b]Developers:[/b]
[*] Camera functions should be called with `:` instead of `.`
[*] `Player:Spawn()` is deprecated, use `Map:AddChild(Player)` instead
[/list]

You can now set how avatars hold the items (position, rotation). Our next step is to do the same to equip items as hats and backpacks!
